why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items, and it breaks neither. Item 1: Check 3 lists the exported functions and says they "must include at least capitalize, slugify, truncate and padLeft". It also says "Watch slugify in particular", so a README with a padLeft section but no slugify section fails. Item 2: the PASS values in Checks 1 and 2 ("00042", "   42", "xxa", unchanged strings) follow directly from the expect lines. There is no parameter-count check and no rule that fill must be one character; the multi-character fill case is marked advisory only. Check 3 defines a section loosely as "a heading naming the function plus text about it", which is a plain reading of "section", not a required layout. The builder's `## name(...)` heading format is only an instruction to the builder, not a pass/fail condition. Exit status and test coverage are advisory too.
